records.reason: Grants an action (a second claw Strike that can leave the target grabbed); everything it does lands on the target and is resolved at the table.
Grants an action; the extra claw Strike and the grabbed condition apply to the target and are resolved at the table.

Grants an activity that Demoralizes enemies and then Strikes; the only self-facing part (no penalty for Demoralizing a creature that can't understand you) removes a penalty on a check made against a target in play.

'Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 4' is a permanent sheet change. derive.ts computes bulk as encumberedAt = 5+strMod and max = 10+strMod with no per-feat adjustment lane (Hefty Hauler is undelivered for the same reason), and no legal field expresses a Bulk-limit bonus.

'You no longer gain silver weakness from Werecreature Dedication' must remove a weakness the app really applies — werecreature-dedication carries weaknesses [{type:'silver',value:'floor(@actor.level/2)'}]. There is no negation/removal lane for an already-granted weakness.
Free action spending a Mythic Point to end a condition, a spell effect, or a hazard's grip in play; nothing persistent on the sheet.

Spending a Mythic Point lets you roll Hide, Sneak, or Stealth-for-initiative at mythic proficiency and become concealed — a real benefit on the character's own Stealth check that nothing records. Mythic-Point situational entries of this shape are established precedent (arc-of-destruction, prescient-parry).

situational.when: when you spend a Mythic Point to Hide, Sneak, or roll Stealth for initiative
situational.bonus: roll at mythic proficiency, and you become concealed

records.reason: 'Your apocalypse mount gains one specialization of your choice' (up to three times). apocalypse-rider-dedication already grants a modelled companion in companionGrants.ts, and COMPANION_MODS expresses exactly this via maturityFloor (see 'specialized-companion'), but no entry exists for this feat. The fix is a companion-registry entry, not a feat field.

'Your construct companion becomes an incredible construct companion' — a maturity-rung upgrade of a companion the app models (rise-my-creature grants it; 'advanced-reanimated-companion' and 'paragon-companion' already register the rungs below and above via maturityFloor). No entry exists for this feat; the fix is a COMPANION_MODS registry entry, not a feat field.
Reaction that alters an ALLY's multiple attack penalty; nothing touches the character's own statistics.
A crit rider dealing 1 persistent damage to the target; damage the target takes, resolved at the table.
One action granting a fly Speed for that single Fly movement only; a speeds entry would be a permanent over-grant.

The Bestial Manifestation unarmed attack gains the deadly d6 trait (the app does compute deadly crit riders on strikes) and gets brawling critical specialization, but only for that one attack. There is no lane to add a trait to an already-granted strike, and critSpec + critSpecWeapons {groups:['brawling']} would hand brawling crit spec to every brawling attack the character has — an over-grant.
Makes creatures that attack you while adjacent to your companion Frightened 1; changes only enemies' statistics.
An action: draw, Strike an off-guard target, then roll Deception for initiative — all resolved in play.

Your agile+finesse melee and unarmed attacks gain the backstabber trait — extra damage on your own Strikes against off-guard creatures. Nothing delivers it; there is no weapon-trait-grant lane and an unconditional damage field would over-grant, so the situational annotation is the correct lane.

situational.when: vs an off-guard foe, with an agile+finesse melee or unarmed attack

records.reason: Chooses which creature sizes can trigger a snare; a property of the placed snare adjudicated at the table, not a sheet statistic.
Raises Cheek Pouches storage from four Light items to 1 Bulk; the app does not model cheek pouches as a container.

Grants your winged animal companions a gust ranged unarmed attack (1d4 bludgeoning, 30 ft, air and propulsive). Companion strikes are rendered on the sheet (companions.ts formats them), but COMPANION_MODS has no attack-grant field — only strikeRider, senses, speeds, and note — so the companion attack lane is missing.
An ikon imbuement adding a Transcendence activation to the chosen weapon ikon; it grants an action whose effect resolves against a target at the table.

Spending a Mythic Point lets you roll your own Grapple (Athletics) at mythic proficiency against a foe an ally already grabbed; that check-side benefit is undelivered, and Mythic-Point situational entries are established precedent in situationalBonuses.ts.

situational.when: when you spend a Mythic Point to Grapple a foe an ally already grabbed
situational.bonus: roll at mythic proficiency (on a success, +2x Str mod bludgeoning damage)

records.reason: Raises the DC OTHER creatures face to Recognize Spells you cast and Identify your magic; it changes checks made against you, not your own statistics.
A spellshape that swaps the damage type of an untamed form attack, chosen at cast time in play.
An activity combining Stride, Black Powder Boost, and a Strike; entirely resolved at the table.
An activity: Strike, then teleport near the target; nothing persistent on the sheet.
Reaction reducing forced movement; the app does not model forced-movement distances.
A two-action Strike with extra damage dice against a qualifying foe; a granted attack resolved at the table.
A two-action Strike with an extra weapon die and 1d8 (2d8 at 18th) spirit damage; damage dealt to the target in play.
A two-action Strike with extra dice and optional vitality conversion against undead; resolved at the table.
The GM decides which of six property runes is inscribed, and it lasts only while you remain in sentinel form; a GM-adjudicated temporary rune on a transformed weapon.
Detection, revelation, and scrying effects fail against you unless their counteract rank is 10 or higher; it constrains other creatures' effects and is adjudicated by the GM.
An action to shoot a lock, resolved with an attack roll against the lock's Pick a Lock DC at the table.
An activity: Grapple, then Strike for 3d6 extra precision damage; in-play resolution against the target.
A deviant ability granting a ranged energy attack and awakened variants; the damage lands on targets, and grantedStrikes describes unarmed weapon strikes, not a level-scaling magical blast.
Reaction granting resistance only against the triggering damage plus reflected fire damage; a resistances field would be a permanent, unconditional over-grant.
A kineticist impulse: an area attack with a save against your class DC, resolved at the table.
An action making a ranged spell attack that inflicts persistent bleed on the target.
A finisher Strike adding persistent bleed to the target; target-side damage resolved in play.
One action granting ghost touch to your shield until the start of your next turn and widening Shield Block's trigger; a one-round in-play effect.

'Add up to three of your deity's spells to your spell list' is a build-time player pick that nothing offers. effectChoices/spellFilter cannot model it, because that would put the spells in the repertoire for free while the feat only makes them selectable with normal repertoire slots — the spell-LIST expansion lane does not exist.
A Strike with an extra damage die that gives the TARGET a weakness; everything lands on the enemy.

A fortune reroll on the character's own failed Medicine check to Treat a Disease inflicted by undead. Nothing records it, and the situational registry already carries pure-reroll fortune entries (acrobats-staff, grit-and-tenacity) and Treat a Disease-adjacent ones (robust-recovery).

situational.when: you fail a check to Treat a Disease inflicted by an undead
situational.bonus: fortune: reroll and use the new result

records.reason: A two-action Strike gaining the holy trait and extra spirit damage; damage dealt to the target in play.
A spellshape adding a counteract attempt to remove a condition from a single ALLY; it changes only the ally's condition.
A Strike forcing a save against your existing class or spell DC to enfeeble the target; both the DC and the effect already resolve at the table.
Waives concealment flat checks and softens hidden/undetected handling; the app rolls no concealment flat checks and tracks no per-enemy detection state, so this is table-resolved.
Lets Blood Rising fire two blood magic effects instead of one; a modification to an in-play reaction's resolution.
Reaction that finishes a disrupted casting in exchange for drained; resolved in play, with drained applied through the conditions tracker.
Swaps spellcasting components for HP loss; components are not tracked by the app and the action cost is unchanged.
A temporary (1-minute) triggered combat state on the EIDOLON; modes are character-scoped in modes.ts, so a mode would apply the -2 AC and temporary HP to the wrong creature.
An action whose Strike ignores concealment and lowers the hidden flat check; flat checks are rolled at the table.
Lowers the flat-check DC to end persistent bleed on yourself; the app tracks no persistent damage on the character or its recovery DC, so this is rolled at the table.
Reaction triggering a blood magic effect you already know; the effect and any bonus resolve in play against the triggering spell.
Pay HP to gain two blood magic effects instead of one; an in-play choice layered on an existing blood magic trigger.
Adds 1d4 persistent bleed to the target on a critical hit; damage the target takes, resolved at the table.

'Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool' changes a resource the app really tracks — the SpellsTab Refocus control restores exactly 1 Focus Point and nothing overrides that amount. focusPoolBonus only enlarges the pool, so no legal field expresses a Refocus-recovery change.
'You recover 3 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1' — the same undelivered lane: the Refocus control hard-restores 1 point and there is no field for a Refocus-recovery amount.
A crit rider dealing 1d4 persistent bleed to the target; target-side damage resolved in play.
Adds one more option to Debilitating Strike; the debilitation is chosen in play and damages the target.
A Strike forcing a save against your existing class DC that restricts the TARGET's reactions; entirely target-side.
